name: maskin
description: Maskin, the open-source workspace where AI agents do the work and people set direction. Connect Cursor to your Maskin workspace over MCP.

MASKIN_API_KEY.title: Maskin API key
MASKIN_API_KEY.description: Your personal Maskin key, starting with ank_. Create one in Maskin under Settings, then Keys.

MASKIN_WORKSPACE_ID.title: Maskin workspace ID
MASKIN_WORKSPACE_ID.description: The ID of the workspace to connect to. It is the first part of the address when you have the workspace open in Maskin.
